name: reaction-picker
title: Reaction Picker
description: A row of reactions drawn as manpu marks (anger, sweat, surprise, question, sparkle, gloom, love, sigh), each a toggle chip with its count in the SFX face: 2px ink frame, sharp corners. A chip is a button with aria-pressed; reacted = ink flat sweeping in (G2), hover thickens the line (G3, small cells), a click hits with speed lines (G4) and the count takes the hit when it changes; new chips pop in (G5). A "+" chip opens the kit Popover bubble (G6) with the eight marks as labelled buttons ("React with anger"); picking one toggles it and closes. Arrow keys move inside the grid. The row wraps; 44px targets under 640px. Controlled: pass reactions and toggle them in onReact. max caps the different kinds in the row; disabled makes it read-only (dashed chips). Exports ReactionChip and ReactionGrid for custom layouts and frozen previews.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/reaction-picker". It uses Manpu ("@/components/manga/manpu"), the kit Popover ("@/components/ui/manga/popover", which wraps your own components/ui/popover, Radix or Base UI) and withImpact, punch and ImpactLines from "@/lib/manga/gestures".

props.name: reactions
props.type: { kind: ManpuKind; count: number; active?: boolean }[]
props.description: The row, in order. active = the reader reacted with it. Entries at 0 that are not active are hidden.

props.name: onReact
props.description: A chip or a mark of the picker was clicked: toggle that kind in your state.

props.name: max
props.description: The most different kinds the row holds; once full, the other marks of the picker are disabled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read-only row: dashed chips, no picker.
